title: Saturday Santa visit in Pontotoc offers free photos and $15 handprint ornaments

paragraphs.text: Children can visit Santa and Mrs. Claus at Lifted Nutrition in Pontotoc from 10 a.m. to noon Saturday, Nov. 21. Families can take their own photos for free. A handprint ornament made during the same two-hour visit costs $15.

The shop is at 269 W. Reynolds St. The organizers ask families to bring a camera for pictures at the balloon arch and invite children to bring letters to leave in Santa’s mailbox. Cookies and milk will be available to children at no charge.

Morgan Voyles will offer the handprint ornaments during the Santa visit. The shop lists its regular Saturday hours as 8 a.m. to 3 p.m., so families who want a photo or an ornament should plan around the shorter morning event.
